name: feasible-minus-k-lns
abstract_description: Start from a known-feasible solution, remove k components, re-optimize the neighborhood with the full solver. Improvement search as large-neighborhood search around feasibility, not blind search from scratch.
origin_result: Laderman-minus-1 + 6-triple K=7 re-optimization; two neighborhoods proven UNSAT in ~10 min each (2026-09-09)
applicability: Any improvement search where a feasible baseline exists
